text: The Yoneda lemma implies that every object c in a locally small category C is completely determined by:
choices: the functor Hom(c, -): C → Set (its covariant representable functor)
the category of morphisms into c
explanation: Yoneda: c ↦ Hom(c,-) is fully faithful. Two objects are isomorphic iff their representable functors are naturally isomorphic. Objects are 'probed' by morphisms from them.
